mentions.name: Delft3D
mentions.description: A port of Delft3D, Deltares' Fortran hydrodynamics engine, to run natively on Apple Silicon. Previously limited to Intel compilers on Windows/Linux, it now builds with gfortran on macOS/arm64, including the PETSc+MPI solver, and runs on a Mac Studio M3. Around 30 bugs were uncovered and fixed along the way, with the port carried out largely by AI agents.
mentions.source_excerpt: I ported a decades-old piece of scientific software (Delft3D — Deltares' Fortran hydrodynamics engine) to run natively on Apple Silicon.
mentions.author: tda
